value: Miniguy RPG with various minigames and extensive linear narrative.

You’ve been transported to another world, finding yourself shrunken in a fantasy land. You meet many other tinies who have similarly been transported from different worlds, and taken under the wing of a witch who is collecting tinies to expand the influence of her magic domain. Together with other tinies, you have to complete quests to defeat mana-drunk monsters who have grown larger than normal, until you can finally find a way back to full size. Time to Complete: <3 hours
Standard RPG mechanics, various enemy evasion minigames, QTEs and stamina-based events
